verse.verse_1: By oath of the night when it covers
verse.verse_2: And by oath of the day when it shines
verse.verse_3: And by oath of the One Who created the male and the female.
verse.verse_5: So for one who gave and practised piety
verse.verse_6: And believed the best matter to be true
verse.verse_7: So We will very soon provide him ease.
verse.verse_8: And for him who hoarded wealth and remained carefree,
verse.verse_10: So We will very soon provide him hardship.
verse.verse_11: His wealth will not avail him when he falls into ruin.
verse.verse_13: And indeed the Hereafter and this world both belong to Us.
verse.verse_14: I therefore warn you of the fire that is ablaze.
verse.verse_15: None except the most wicked will enter it.
verse.verse_16: The one who denied and turned away.
verse.verse_17: He will be far away from the most pious. (The first Caliph S. Abu Bakr Siddiq)
verse.verse_18: Who gives his wealth in order to be pure.
verse.verse_19: And no one has done a favour to him, for which he should be compensated.
verse.verse_20: He desires only to please his Lord, the Supreme.
verse.verse_21: And indeed, soon he will be very pleased.
